story_arc.initial_state_or_goal: At the village lane, Ninereeds sees two distinct recurring participants, Taro and Emma, pause near the same gate. One participant waves, but the event begins with an identity uncertainty: Ninereeds needs to identify whether the greeter is Taro or Emma before answering.
story_arc.meaningful_development: The waving participant faces Ninereeds and asks, "Who are you?" Ninereeds asks, "Are you Taro or Emma?" The participant shown with the canonical Taro reference answers, "I'm Taro." The visible participant, voice, and answer resolve the uncertainty together; Emma remains the other distinct participant.
story_arc.resolution_or_stopping_state: Ninereeds answers, "Hello! I'm Ninereeds." Taro and Ninereeds face one another and exchange "Nice to meet you." and "Nice to meet you, too." The greeting stops with Taro still the same depicted participant and Ninereeds still the first-person learner identity.
continuity_bindings: Ninereeds uses canonical-mind-ninereeds-v1 as the first-person learner mind/device representation.
Taro uses canonical-person-taro-nakamura-v1 as the greeter and identity answerer on every page.
Emma uses canonical-person-emma-v1 as the distinct visible identity candidate on every page.
The Village Lane uses canonical-location-village-lane-village-lane-establishing-v1 as the single continuous setting.
story_arc.coherence_test: Removing page 1 removes the visible two-person uncertainty; removing page 2 removes the identity question and its visual-and-verbal resolution; removing page 3 removes the resulting reciprocal greeting. Reordering the pages would make the answer precede the uncertainty or make the reciprocity precede the identification.

pages.visual_event: A single village-lane view shows canonical Taro and canonical Emma as two distinct participants near the same gate. Taro is the one raising a hand toward Ninereeds; Emma stands beside him and remains separate. Ninereeds is represented by the canonical mind/device representation at the edge of the scene.
scene_facts: Two visible recurring participants are available as identity candidates: Taro and Emma.
The wave is an event cue from the participant who will answer; the identity is not yet resolved by the first page alone.
The same village-lane setting and the same three participant representations continue to the next page.

pages.visual_event: Without changing the setting or identities, the waving participant faces Ninereeds and points to himself while the other participant remains beside the gate. The canonical Taro participant is the one whose speech identifies him.
scene_facts: The participant who answers is the same canonical Taro participant who waved on page 1.
The answer resolves the choice between Taro and Emma through a persistent depicted participant and matching identity language.
Emma remains a distinct visible participant and does not answer in Taro's place.

pages.visual_event: Ninereeds and the same canonical Taro participant face one another at the gate after the identity is clear. Emma remains distinct in the background. The participants finish the greeting with reciprocal friendly attention.
scene_facts: Ninereeds is the first-person speaker who says "I'm Ninereeds."
The reciprocal meeting phrases close the greeting after Taro's identity has been established.
Taro remains Taro and Emma remains Emma at the stopping state.
